subsystem.name: VehiclePhysics
subsystem.responsibility: Per-vehicle physics and closely coupled presentation: wheel/brake/suspension dynamics, collision detection and response over 13 contact slots, telemetry position accumulation, grid-collision particle effects, dashboard/HUD cue dispatch, reflection-map view init, and indirect physics dispatch thunks. Grouping reflects the packet scope, not a claim about original source organization.

summary: Vehicle physics subsystem proposal over 17 functions. A VehiclePhysics core (five methods sharing a this layout of orientation/position/mode-selector/wheel data) covers brake+suspension integration, per-vehicle and per-frame collision contact, telemetry accumulation and mode-dispatched grid-collision. VehicleDashboardHUD drives per-frame dashboard/cue presentation. Supporting types: VehicleRenderObject element iterators, VehicleViewObject + VehicleReflectionMapView (view construction and parameter forwarding), VehicleCollisionSampleState (contact/audio records), PhysicsInterfaceDispatcher thunks, and WheelForceTransformer (chassis-frame force transform). Free helpers: TireTemperatureLookup (category->value mapping) and DualMatrixTransformMultiply (transform composition). Two fixed contracts (tire temperature mapping, reflection-map entry requirements) are directly evidenced; physics-mode and collision-slot dispatch contracts are DERIVED from control flow. 26 global float constants remain semantically unresolved.

function_roles.role: Per-frame vehicle dashboard/HUD update: transform propagation, wheel pose/colour, component cue dispatch, low-grip/gear/byte-flag change detection, gauge scaling.
Iterates the object's 748-byte element records, dispatching a reference-position offset vector to each via 0x004DEF70; returns the element count.
Per-vehicle wheel render iteration over stride-0xBB0 sub-objects, calling ConditionalRenderCall on each; re-reads the count from this[746] each pass.
Per-frame wheel/brake/suspension dynamics: timestep-scaled torque rotation into chassis frame, gyroscopic terms, per-wheel sub-update, brake-pressure state machine.

Per-vehicle collision contact: local transform of contact point, AABB overlap test, packed geometry closest-vertex search, contact normal/depth, response buffer write and proximity/projection refinement.
Per-frame collision detection/response over 13 contact slots: packet read, world transform, opponent grid lookup, impulse/severity response, collision result-list report.
Accumulates velocity-scaled deltas into position, transforms them by the 3x3 rotation matrix, then dispatches by update-mode selector (0 rigid-body / 2 stride-resolved target).

Per-frame physics dispatch on this+0x32BC: mode 0 tire slip-force, mode 1 per-wheel suspension contact + throttle/brake override, modes 2/3 spatial-grid collision with particle/spark effects; common tail commits aggregate contact.
Maps a tire temperature category name to a numeric value via cascading string compares (first category 32.5, Warm 26.25, Medium 20.0, Cool 13.75, Cold via 0x0058850F, default 7.5).

Stores collision surface contact value/type with a [current-5.0,current] tolerance band; descriptor flag bits (0xFC0000) select Euler-to-orientation (0x004B2DD0/0x004B32A0) vs arithmetic-comparison (0x004B3A90) update.
Threshold-guarded collision audio sample handler: clamps delta to [0.001,0.5], interpolates audio parameters and cross-fades the collision sample, then copies arithmetic state to the output buffer.
Trivial indirect-dispatch thunk: calls the function pointer at off_5D76C0 with no arguments and returns its result.
Trivial indirect-forwarding thunk: calls the function pointer at off_5D76C4 with no arguments and returns its result.
Transforms per-wheel suspension forces into the chassis frame via a device-wrapper vtable at 0x008B8F24, iterating 6 wheel entries and accumulating the chassis position offset.
Stores a caller-supplied parameter at +0x19C and forwards four view fields (+0x54/+0x58/+0x64/+0x68) plus flag 1 to 0x00542200; returns 0 when the parameter is zero.
Reflection-map view initializer: entry scan (stride 148, +96 bit 0x800000, +64 bit 2), error logging, child VehicleViewObject construction and parameter/sound/colour setup.
Two-stage transform composition over six dword operands via 0x0054B4A0 then 0x0054B420; sits on the scene-render transform chain (callers include SceneRenderTransform 0x00548C20).

classes.name: VehiclePhysics
classes.responsibility: Per-frame vehicle dynamics and collision core: wheel torque/suspension/brake integration (0x004E5AE0), per-vehicle collision contact (0x004EA040), per-frame collision detection over 13 contact slots (0x004EA970), telemetry position accumulation (0x004EC080), and the physics-mode dispatch that selects slip-force, suspension-contact or grid-collision handlers (0x004EE2D0). Only 0x004EE2D0 carries a packet DERIVED owner; the shared this layout (orientation at +0x34B0, position at +0x34D4, mode selector at +0x32BC, wheel data at +0x3590) is the grouping basis and remains a proposal.

classes.name: VehicleDashboardHUD
classes.responsibility: Per-frame vehicle dashboard/HUD: propagates the vehicle transform and wheel poses, drives per-component cue slots, detects low-grip/gear/byte-flag state changes and dispatches sound/visual cues via 0x005506A0, and scales the speedometer/gauge readout (2.0943952 rad rotation, flt_7CF740 gauge scaling).

classes.name: VehicleRenderObject
classes.responsibility: Per-vehicle render/visual element container: iterates an array of stride-0xBB0 wheel sub-objects (0x004E3A10, called from 0x004B3400) and an array of 748-byte element records, dispatching a reference-position offset transform to each via 0x004DEF70 (0x004E3940). Element count held at this+0xBA8.

classes.name: VehicleViewObject
classes.responsibility: Suspension/view parameter object: stores a caller-supplied parameter at +0x19C and forwards four float/double fields (+0x54/+0x58/+0x64/+0x68) plus a literal flag into 0x00542200 (0x00542560). Set up by VehicleReflectionMapInit on a freshly constructed 444-byte child object.

classes.name: VehicleReflectionMapView
classes.responsibility: Reflection-map view initializer: scans the render-entry array for an entry with +96 bit 0x800000 and +64 bit 2 set, logs 'No Reflection Map'/'Reflection Map' errors on failure, and on the full-init path (a2==2) constructs a 444-byte VehicleViewObject child with sound instance, colour, scale and suspension parameters.

classes.name: VehicleCollisionSampleState
classes.responsibility: Small collision-contact/audio state record: tolerance-filtered contact value and 3-bit type storage (0x00500010) and a threshold-guarded collision audio sample handler with parameter interpolation and cross-fade (0x00500560). Shares FloatComparisonCheck (0x005001F0) and arithmetic-state copy (0x004B3A90).

classes.name: PhysicsInterfaceDispatcher
classes.responsibility: Indirect dispatch thunks over two adjacent function-pointer slots (off_5D76C0 / off_5D76C4): 0x00503659 and 0x005038EF dereference the stored pointer, call it with no arguments and return its result. Invoked per-interface from COMInterfaceVectorProcessingMethod (0x00504B37).

classes.name: WheelForceTransformer
classes.responsibility: Transforms per-wheel suspension forces from wheel frame into chassis frame: copies a 4x4 matrix from +0x15C, iterates 6 wheel entries (16 bytes each from +0x104) through a device-wrapper vtable at global 0x008B8F24, and accumulates chassis offset (+0x24/+0x28/+0x2C).

state_machines.name: PhysicsModeSelector
transitions: selector at this+0x32BC selects handler via jump table global 0x004EF168

state_machines.name: BrakePressureStateMachine
transitions: pressure state at this+0x3994 init 0; this+0x3978<=0 or zero pressure re-zeros with bias this+0x39A0*this+0x398C*dt; mode at this+0x39F0 drives blend (mode1, flag this+0x39EC) or snap (mode2); clamped to this+0x3998..this+0x399C

state_machines.name: CollisionContactSlotLoop
transitions: 13 slots per frame; slots 10-11 gated by this+0x3B74 and this+0xD0C/this+0xD4C; impulse reported to 0x0041AD80(dword_5EB978, ...)

interfaces.name: PhysicsDispatchTable
interfaces.purpose: Indirect dispatch slots off_5D76C0/off_5D76C4 invoked per-interface from COMInterfaceVectorProcessingMethod; targets resolved at runtime.

interfaces.name: CollisionGeometryAccessor
interfaces.purpose: Packed collision-geometry list access: list handle via LinkedListIndexedAccessor_c230, total size via PackedArrayTotalSize, per-vertex fetch via PackedArrayIndexLookup.

interfaces.name: SpatialGrid
interfaces.purpose: Spatial-grid collision query used by the grid-collision physics modes and the common tail; grid global dbl_7C9360.

compatibility_contracts.name: PhysicsModeSelectorContract
compatibility_contracts.description: A replacement must preserve the physics-mode dispatch on this+0x32BC: 0 = tire slip-force (0x004472B0), 1 = per-wheel suspension contact + throttle/brake override (0x004EE230), 2/3 = spatial-grid collision with particle/spark effects; jump table global 0x004EF168.

compatibility_contracts.name: CollisionSlotContract
compatibility_contracts.description: A replacement must process 13 collision contact slots per frame, read each event packet (0x0054FA90), gate slots 10-11 on this+0x3B74 and this+0xD0C/this+0xD4C, and report impulses to the collision result list via 0x0041AD80(dword_5EB978, vehicleId, matchedVehicle, impulse).

compatibility_contracts.name: TireTemperatureMappingContract
compatibility_contracts.description: A replacement must map tire temperature category names to the same numeric values: first category 32.5, Warm 26.25, Medium 20.0, Cool 13.75, Cold computed via 0x0058850F, default 7.5.

compatibility_contracts.name: DashboardCueDispatchContract
compatibility_contracts.description: A replacement must dispatch dashboard cues only when the corresponding slot at this+0x898..0x8B0 is active, emit state-change cues via 0x005506A0 for low-grip/gear/byte-flag/gauge changes, and scale the speedometer rotation by 2.0943952 and the gauge by flt_7CF740.

compatibility_contracts.name: ReflectionMapEntryContract
compatibility_contracts.description: A replacement must require a render entry whose +96 dword has bit 0x800000 set and whose +64 byte has bit 2 set for reflection-map construction; failure logs 'No Reflection Map'/'Reflection Map' and returns -1.

unresolved: Many read-only float globals (0x59E420, 0x59E43C..0x59EAE0, 0x5AC108, 0x5AC988, 0x5AD1DC, 0x5AD328..0x5AD358) are recorded as read by the skeleton facts but do not appear as named references in the decompiled bodies; they are likely physics tuning/ramp constants folded into arithmetic (rotation scale, brake/travel ramps, 4-bit contact scaling). Exact mapping unverified.

The shared this layout used to group the five VehiclePhysics methods (orientation at +0x34B0, position at +0x34D4, mode selector at +0x32BC, wheel blocks at +0x3590/+0x3580) is proposal-level: only 0x004EE2D0 carries a packet DERIVED owner; equal offsets on unrelated this pointers do not prove identical classes.
Semantics and side effects of VirtualDispatchHelper (0x0040C870), InterruptDispatch (0x0058957A) and Delegation (0x004B9CE0) on global session state are not resolved from this packet.
Meaning of the bit flags produced by the VirtualDispatchHelper call in 0x004E19D0 is unclear.
Gauge value semantics (lap segment versus speed readout) and the sub_58850F computation for the Cold tire category are not determinable from this packet alone.

Field this+0x3610 is listed in the deterministic field list but does not appear in the decompilation; role unknown. Global unk_8AFEC0 is a read-only object referenced per the fact table but not visible in decompiled immediates.

Exact structure of the collision event packet buffers returned by ArithmeticComparison_a010 (0x004EA010) and the packed collision-geometry list behind LinkedListIndexedAccessor_c230/PackedArrayIndexLookup are inferred from usage, not an independent source.

The indirect targets behind off_5D76C0/off_5D76C4 and the device wrapper at global 0x008B8F24 are resolved at runtime; their classes and exact math are not statically bound here. 0x00503888 and 0x005038C0 are related dispatch-path functions not directly reached by 0x00503659/0x005038EF.

Purpose of FieldReadDelegate (0x004E16C0) on the matrix region and which object the obj+0x4894 field selects in the stride-based lookup of 0x004EC080 are unknown; dbl_7C7428 as a race-time scalar is DERIVED from the fill, not independently confirmed.
The a2/a4 argument semantics and the a3 descriptor layout in 0x00500010, plus sub_588410 return convention (0 == match) in 0x004FE2B0, are inferred from usage patterns.

The 4x4 matrix copy in 0x00541A70 is described as a rotation matrix only from existing analysis (DERIVED); the packet shows a raw 16-dword copy. Wheel stride (16 bytes) and pivot-float meanings are DERIVED from indexing arithmetic.
The viewport-dimension interpretation of the four fields forwarded by 0x00542560 to 0x00542200 is existing-analysis prose (DERIVED), not verifiable from the raw source.
The two string globals aReflectionMapp/aRefview/aNoReflectionMa (0x5DBEC8/0x5DBEC0/0x5DBE94) contents are not shown; their exact text is unverified.
Composition role of 0x0054B530 (DualMatrixTransformMultiply) and its six dword operands is unknown; callers pass different operand groupings and the owning object is unresolved.
